title: AmharicStoryQA: A Multicultural Story Question Answering Benchmark in Amharic

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing zero-shot and fine-tuned LLM performance on story-based question answering tasks (both multiple-choice and generative) across narratives originating from nine different cultural regions within Ethiopia.
Comparing model comprehension and performance disparities on narrative tasks when using Amharic versus English stories and prompts.
